description: Snapshot a live server's structure into a blueprint: roles, categories, channels, and their visibility, with permission overwrites decompiled back into private_to and read_only where they fit and warnings where they do not. Each item carries its id, so editing the export and planning it with update_existing renames and changes those exact items. Optionally save the result straight to the store with save_as.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

include_ids.description: Default true. False for a design meant for other servers.

save_as.description: Save the export under this blueprint name.

name: export_server_blueprint
title: Export server blueprint
